title: GitHub Token Permissions: Give Your AI Agent Less
description:
Your AI agent doesn't need your full GitHub token. 🔑

✅ Make a fine-grained token for one repo, read-only
✅ Hand the agent only that token
✅ Watch a write attempt get blocked with a 403

Day 8 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 9: Run Agents in a Dev Container.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #aiagents #aicoding #aitools #cybersecurity #github #claudecode
comment: Read-only or write access: which would you grant first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: set an expiry date on the token so it stops working on its own.
